question: The first Olympics games were held inA. U.K.B. U.S.A.C. GreeceD. Italy (RRB NTPC Tier I (30/03/2016) Shift 3)

solution:

Explanation:
The first modern Olympic Games were held in Athens, Greece in 1896. This revival was spearheaded by Pierre de Coubertin, who also founded the International Olympic Committee (IOC) in 1894. The ancient Olympic Games, dating back to 776 BC, were also held in Greece at Olympia. The first modern Olympics featured 241 athletes from 13 countries competing in 43 events. Since then, the Olympic Games have been held every four years, except in 1916, 1940, and 1944 due to the World Wars.

question: The periodicity of the Commonwealth games isA. No fixed intervalB. 4 yearsC. 5 yearsD. 6 years (RRB NTPC Tier I (30/03/2016) Shift 3)

question: The first Commonwealth Games in 1930 was held in which country? (RRB JE ME (31/08/2019) CBT 2)
options: Australia
England
New Zealand
Canada
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Canada

Explanation:
The first Commonwealth Games were held in 1930 in Hamilton, Canada. They were originally called the 'British Empire Games'. The event featured over 400 athletes from 11 countries. The aim was to promote friendship and sportsmanship among the nations of the British Empire. These Games are held every four years, except for 1942 and 1946 due to World War II. After 1930, the next Games were held in London, England in 1934. The name was later changed to 'British Empire and Commonwealth Games' in 1954, and finally to 'Commonwealth Games' in 1970. Today, over 70 nations participate in the Games.
